name: US equity stress
summary: VIX closed at 24.6 on 18 Nov and the S&P 500 sits 6.3% below its high, inside both Watch bands
state: The VIX closed near 24.6 on 18 Nov, up 31% on the week and above the 20 Watch line (Yahoo Finance). The S&P 500 ended near 7,324, 6.3% below its 52-week high of 7,819 and 3.5% lower on the week, as chip shares fell ahead of Nvidia's results (JournalArta, 18 Nov). Its worst day of the past five sessions was a 1.9% fall. No VIX close above 30 or circuit breaker was recorded.
for_you: US shares are in a correction with volatility elevated. Pensions and investment funds with US equity exposure may show short-term swings.
rubric_hit: VIX 22.1 ≥ 20 Watch line; S&P drawdown 6.33% ≥ 5% Watch line

sources.title: JournalArta — Wall Street close: Dow sheds 1.65% as chip shares sink

why: The S&P 500 is the world's risk barometer; sharp falls and spiking volatility transmit to pensions, credit and confidence globally.
drivers: Earnings, interest-rate expectations, liquidity, geopolitical shocks, positioning and leverage.

rubric.alert: VIX > 30, or drawdown > 15%, or a market-wide circuit breaker trips.
rubric.normal: VIX < 20 and S&P 500 drawdown from 52-week high < 5%.
